description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractIndexer' which provides common methods and properties for implementing search indexers within the SuiteCRM system. It includes logging setup, module management, and indexing control functionalities.

classes.name: AbstractIndexer
classes.description: An abstract class providing foundational methods and properties for search indexer implementations, including logging, module management, and differential indexing control.

methods.name: getIndexerName
methods.description: Returns the short class name of the indexer.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Abstract method to perform indexing of the entire database; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: indexModule
methods.description: Abstract method to index a specific module; implementation required in subclasses.

methods.name: indexBean
methods.description: Abstract method to index a single SugarBean; implementation required in subclasses.

methods.name: indexBeans
methods.description: Abstract method to index multiple SugarBeans; implementation required in subclasses.

methods.name: removeBean
methods.description: Abstract method to remove a bean from the index; implementation required in subclasses.

methods.name: removeBeans
methods.description: Abstract method to remove multiple beans from the index; implementation required in subclasses.

methods.name: removeIndex
methods.description: Abstract method to delete all records from a specified index; implementation required in subclasses.

methods.name: isDifferentialIndexing
methods.description: Checks if differential indexing is enabled.

methods.name: getDocumentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the current documentifier used for converting beans into index documents.

methods.name: setDocumentifier
methods.description: Sets the documentifier for future indexing operations.

methods.name: getDocumentifierName
methods.description: Returns the class name of the current documentifier.

methods.name: getModulesToIndex
methods.description: Returns the list of modules to be indexed.

methods.name: setModulesToIndex
methods.description: Overrides the list of modules to be indexed.

methods.name: addModulesToIndex
methods.description: Adds modules to the list of modules to be indexed.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves the internal Monolog logger instance.

methods.name: setupLogger
methods.description: Initializes the logger with handlers for SugarCRM, file logging, and CLI output.

methods.name: getObjectClassName
methods.description: Utility method to get the short class name of an object using reflection.
